liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Can't Put My Finger on It** (1 other source): The Chant leads into this song, with a lyric about meeting her at a Living JRAD show [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Stallion pt 2**: rare: 10 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **ween2018-12-15** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 132 min [1]
- **Ween2018-12-15.MK012**: source not stated; 29 songs; 130 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **ween2018-12-15.cd2go**: source not stated; 28 songs; 131 min [3]
- **Ween2018-12-15.AK40.FLAC**: source not stated; 28 songs; 130 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2018-12-15**: source: SBD [1]
- **Ween2018-12-15.MK012**: taped by zachariah boes; source: Oktava MK-012 [2]. Also: Recorded with Oktava MK012 microphones into a Fostex FR2LE recorder, with a 10ft position noted [2]
- **ween2018-12-15.cd2go**: taped by James Bonaiuto; transferred by James Bonaiuto; source: Tascam TM-PC1 > Tascam DR-100 MKIII [wav @ 24-bit/48kHz] [3]
- **Ween2018-12-15.AK40.FLAC**: taped by Melissa Fry; transferred by Melissa Fry; source: Neumann AK40> Sound Devices 722 [4]
